sentences.en: Farmers in agrarian States, as their campaign against oleomargarine demonstrated, also felt aggrieved by what they thought was unfair competition.

sentences.en: Butter won, and oleomargarine was taxed and placed under other restraints that persisted on the Federal level until 1950.

sentences.en: Other examples are: the fat of meats, bone-marrow, suet (the best found around the loin and kidneys of the beef creature), cocoanut butter, butterine , and oleomargarine.

sentences.en: The first prolonged and impassioned controversy in the Congress involving a pure food issue took place in 1886, pitting the reigning champion, butter, against a challenger, oleomargarine.
sentences.vi: Cuộc tranh cãi kéo dài và nóng nảy đầu tiên trong Đại hội liên quan đến vấn đề thực phẩm thuần túy diễn ra vào năm 1886, khiến nhà vô địch trị vì, bơ, chống lại một kẻ thách thức, oleomargarine.
